tools.name: tollbooth_pricing_quote
tools.description: Estimate monthly x402 earnings in integer USD microdollars. x402 USDC goes straight to your payTo wallet with 0% Red Center fee. Also returns the one-time pass prices: Pro $39 (one project) and Agency $79 (multiple projects) for hosted Base mainnet settlement.

tools.name: tollbooth_wallet_balance
tools.description: Inspect a prepaid agent wallet credit balance, status, and remaining UTC daily spend cap. Wallets pay Red Center Studio routes only. Read-only. Needs the wallet key for that wallet (Authorization: Bearer rcs_wk_...).

tools.name: tollbooth_issue_receipt
tools.description: Issue a short-lived Rail B rcs_receipt bearer token (Ed25519-signed, verifiable with /.well-known/tollbooth-jwks.json) that spends from an existing prepaid wallet balance, for Red Center Studio routes only. Needs the wallet key for that wallet. Does not move bank or crypto funds.

tools.name: tollbooth_verify_x402
tools.description: Verify an x402 V2 exact payment: EIP-712 TransferWithAuthorization signature recovered against the payer, USDC asset and network, recipient, amount, expiry and replay records. Read-only; does not execute on-chain transfers.

tools.name: tollbooth_create_topup_checkout
tools.description: Return a Stripe Checkout or sandbox link URL that a user can open in a browser to purchase a Pro ($39 USD once) or Agency ($79 USD once) Pass for hosted Base mainnet settlement. The developer account needs a payout wallet. Prepaid wallet top-ups are not open yet. Never charges automatically.

tools.name: tollbooth_register_wallet
tools.description: Create an empty prepaid agent wallet (for Red Center Studio routes only) and return its wallet ID and wallet key (shown once). Moves no money. Wallet top-ups are not open yet; developers are paid directly with x402 instead.

tools.name: tollbooth_ledger_history
tools.description: List recent ledger entries (earnings history: top-ups, charges, settlements) for a wallet or a developer account, newest first. Read-only. Needs that account's wallet or developer key.

tools.name: tollbooth_pass_status
tools.description: Show a developer account's tier and whether hosted Base mainnet settlement is on. Pro and Agency Passes turn on hosted Base mainnet settlement. Read-only. Needs the developer key.
